verdict.rationale: Ledger anomaly and duplicate detection is a fair question for accounting software, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a bank transactions API that a developer could use to build monitoring, plus adjacent features (smart categorisation, Smart Capture transaction matching). None of it documents an agent or built-in capability that flags spend anomalies or duplicate transactions before the close.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close
